infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RESQ-Link uses the camera to photograph your government ID for identity verification and to attach images to emergency reports you choose to submit.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RESQ-Link uses your photo library so you can upload a government ID photo for identity verification or attach images to emergency reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RESQ-Link uses your location to attach accurate coordinates to emergency reports and to help fill your registration address when you choose to use current location.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: RESQ-Link does not access your contacts. This description is required because a bundled system library references the Contacts API; the app never reads or stores contact information.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to report emergencies accurately and attach coordinates to incident reports.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to report emergencies accurately and attach coordinates to incident reports.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to report emergencies accurately and attach coordinates to incident reports.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos so you can upload a government ID image or attach photos to emergency reports.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to photograph your government ID or attach photos to emergency reports.
